description:
The Nolita GT is a real pleasure for commuting - take the long way home! This sporty bike accompanies you reliably in everyday life and on weekends. It is a real 365-day bike, robust and safe in all weathers on the way to work and sporty for gravel tours. As a city bike with sporty derailleur gears, it feels comfortable on all surfaces, from paved roads to gravel paths. The versatile 28-inch wheels guarantee speed and efficiency, while the drop-style handlebars allow for a sporty yet comfortable riding position. Customize your bike or choose one of our stylish Select models - with the Nolita GT you can explore streets away from the hustle and bustle of traffic and experience the freedom of cycling to the fullest.
Where does Nolita get its name from? In Nolita, the hip NYC district, urban lifestyle combines with cycling culture. Discover the area by bike, enjoy street art, trendy cafes and boutiques. The Nolita GT bike fits perfectly here: sporty for the city and adventurous for gravel tours on the weekend. A real pleasure to explore the district on two wheels. Take the long way home in Nolita!
